task.title: Build 66 1:37 PM Strength attempt: server correlation + why no Command Network Diagnostics entry appeared

result.summary: Zero-write Server correlation for the 1:37 PM PT (20:37 UTC) window confirms the reconciliation command never reached the Server -- zero command_receipts rows for workout-reconciliation.resolve.v1 all-time for this account, zero api.request.failed or any other trace in the application run logs for that command in the full hour around the attempt. Separately confirmed by direct read of the shipped 04a58911 source: CommandNetworkDiagnosticsTransport is correctly wired into the reconciliation path (AppEnvironment -> productionNativeAPI -> submitCommand's three perform() call sites), but has zero UI surface anywhere in the app (exhaustive git grep across the whole ios/PhysiqueOS tree finds it only in its own definition file, AppEnvironment's wiring, and two doc comments) -- a real, confirmed gap, independent of this specific failure. Traced every throw site in the reconciliation submission path in the shipped code: every network-layer failure (perform()'s catch, for all four possible send attempts across the outer call and its retry) unconditionally logs to NetworkFailureDiagnostics before rethrowing, and that diagnostic's storage/view code has no bug that could hide a real entry -- since the Founder found no new entry there either, none of those throw sites fired. That confines the actual throw to code that runs before any network call is attempted in submitCommand (most likely a local JSON-encode failure, which is caught and rethrown without touching either diagnostic) or, less likely given zero server trace, a post-response guard that requires a completed round trip. Also confirmed withBackgroundExecutionAssertion runs the operation on the same calling Task (no detached Task), so taskWasCancelledAtCatch:false remains a trustworthy signal. No fix implemented and no build cut, per instruction.

zero_write_forensics.summary: command_receipts (all-time + windowed +/- both 20/40min and full hour) and application run logs cross-checked for 2026-09-27 20:07-21:07 UTC. Zero reconciliation-command trace anywhere; only two unrelated healthkit.observations.ingest.v1 receipts in the window.

source_inspection.summary: Direct git grep + read of the exact shipped Build 66 commit 04a58911: AppEnvironment.swift, FounderServerAPI.swift (perform/submitCommand), EvidenceReviewAPI.swift (resolveWorkoutReconciliation), BackgroundExecutionAssertion.swift, NetworkFailureDiagnostics.swift, WorkoutReconciliationDiagnostics.swift, WorkoutReconciliationDiagnosticsView.swift all read in full to trace every throw site.

unexpected_findings: CommandNetworkDiagnostics (Build 66's new command-transport diagnostic) has zero UI surface anywhere in the shipped app -- built and wired at the code level but never displayed. Confirmed by exhaustive git grep across the whole ios/PhysiqueOS tree at the exact shipped commit.

WorkoutReconciliationDiagnosticsView DOES render a full underlying-error domain/code/description line for every submit_threw event; the Founder's relayed summary of the 1:37 PM row didn't include that line's exact text, which would likely confirm or correct the local-encode-failure hypothesis directly. Not requesting a new attempt or search for this -- noted only in case it's convenient next time that screen is open.

The reconciliation command has now failed to reach the Server on every attempt across four consecutive builds (61, 64, 65, 66) despite two independently-shipped, independently-reviewed fix candidates targeting different theories (background-execution assertion; dedicated command transport/connection-pool isolation) -- neither changed this specific server-side-silence outcome, meaning the actual failure point is upstream of both fixes.
backlog: If the local-encode-failure hypothesis holds, two fixes are needed together: (1) make submitCommand's pre-network encode failure observable (it currently collapses to .invalidResponse with no diagnostic capture at all), (2) add the missing CommandNetworkDiagnostics display section to WorkoutReconciliationDiagnosticsView. Neither implemented yet, per instruction not to cut another build or add another fix until this is explained.
The Server-side payload-reduction plan from the prior report remains unimplemented.
Two ChatGPT master-thread-context handoffs remain unread in the inbox, out of scope for this task.
recommended_next_step: Awaiting Founder review of this diagnosis. No further Strength attempt or diagnostics search is being requested. If the Founder is willing to relay the exact 'Underlying: <domain> #<code> - <description>' text already shown on the existing WorkoutReconciliationDiagnostics screen for the 1:37 PM submit_threw row, that would directly confirm or correct the local-encode-failure hypothesis before any fix is authorized.
